text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ wins the senior division
URA
award. During her interview, she's
asked about
her leg injury and her
sister's absence, but her
answers are
vague.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ challenges Нарита Брайан
to a
scrimmage. However, there's a sense
of
awkwardness to the moment.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан tells her that if they're going
to face
each other, she wants it to be in
a G1 race and
declines the invitation.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But she has no way of knowing why Biwa

Hayahide challenged her...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
